title: liberator_has_repo and liberator_repo have no caller
body:
lib/liberator.sh defines liberator_has_repo and liberator_repo. Nothing calls either one: not lib/, not bin/, not liberators/, not Molt-matts. Only test/git.bats tests them.

Fix: delete both, and their git.bats tests.

Found by ac's 24 Oct doc review (code notes); vc routed it to dc.
